A vocative particle used in addressing persons, and translateable by ‘o’, ‘sir’, ‘oh’, ‘halloo’, (??) ‘ah’; (it drops its final visarga before vowels and soft consonants); कः कोऽत्र भोः [[Ś. 2]]; अयि भो महर्षिपुत्र [[Ś. 7]]; it is sometimes repeated; भो भोः शंकरगृहाधिवासिनो जानपदाः [[
